WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
store_facts AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           ss.ss_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_range AS dr1 ON dr1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN date_range AS dr2 ON dr2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),
store_summary AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(sf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(sf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(sf.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(sf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_facts AS sf
    JOIN store AS st ON sf.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
catalog_facts AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN date_range AS dr3 ON dr3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
           cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns AS cr
    JOIN date_range AS dr4 ON dr4.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
),
catalog_summary AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(cf.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(cf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_facts AS cf
    JOIN catalog_page AS cp ON cf.page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_sales_facts AS (
    SELECT wsal.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
           wsal.ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           wsal.ws_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM web_sales AS wsal
    JOIN date_range AS dr5 ON dr5.d_date_sk = wsal.ws_sold_date_sk
),
web_return_facts AS (
    SELECT wsal.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           wrt.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           wrt.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns AS wrt
    JOIN web_sales AS wsal
      ON wrt.wr_item_sk = wsal.ws_item_sk
     AND wrt.wr_order_number = wsal.ws_order_number
    JOIN date_range AS dr6 ON dr6.d_date_sk = wrt.wr_returned_date_sk
),
web_facts AS (
    SELECT site_sk, sales_price, profit, return_amt, net_loss
    FROM web_sales_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT site_sk, sales_price, profit, return_amt, net_loss
    FROM web_return_facts
),
web_summary AS (
    SELECT site.web_site_id,
           SUM(wf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(wf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(wf.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(wf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_facts AS wf
    JOIN web_site AS site ON wf.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY site.web_site_id
),
channel_summary AS (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('store', ss.s_store_id) AS id,
           ss.sales AS sales,
           ss.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (ss.profit - ss.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM store_summary AS ss
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('catalog_page', cs.cp_catalog_page_id) AS id,
           cs.sales AS sales,
           cs.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (cs.profit - cs.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM catalog_summary AS cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('web_site', ws.web_site_id) AS id,
           ws.sales AS sales,
           ws.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (ws.profit - ws.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM web_summary AS ws
)
SELECT ch.channel,
       ch.id,
       SUM(ch.sales) AS sales,
       SUM(ch.`returns`) AS `returns`,
       SUM(ch.profit) AS profit
FROM channel_summary AS ch
GROUP BY ch.channel, ch.id WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY ch.channel, ch.id
LIMIT 100
